title: A night in the Pu Luong valley
pace: One valley, on foot or a bicycle
summary: One night in a stilt house and the next morning on the terraces. Thursday or Sunday, Phố Đoàn is the other morning.

days.title: Day 1 — Evening in the hamlet
days.body: Sleep in a stilt house, at Bản Đôn in xã Pù Luông or around Bản Hiêu in xã Cổ Lũng. After dark the hamlet floor is a campfire, rượu cần, xòe, and khắp. A start time is check on arrival. There is no bar street.

days.title: Day 2 — Morning on the terraces
days.body: Walk the fields while the mist is still on the slopes. Late May to early June is the green crop. September and October are the gold crop. A trekking note calls both windows golden. On Thursday or Sunday, Phố Đoàn is the other morning. A bicycle is the usual hire between the hamlets. The charge is check on arrival.

seoTitle: A night in the Pu Luong valley
seoDescription: One night in a stilt house and a morning on the terraces. Hanoi is about 160 km or about 210 km. Rice is green in late May to early June and gold in September and October.
